scope: Resume the preserved chicken EDTA TIR-Learner checkpoint after a runtime compatibility failure, then continue the unchanged EDTA filter/final/annotation stages in a fresh output directory.

native_contract.parameters: --species others --sensitive 1 --anno 1 --threads 16; no curated library, CDS, exclude BED, or --force

compatibility_patch.get_fasta_sequence: Replace only the nested-Pool swifter apply in get_fasta_pieces_single_seqid with pandas DataFrame.apply(axis=1); no coordinate cast until fixture proves one is needed
compatibility_patch.check_TIR_TSD: Replace family=x[0] at both call sites with family=x["TIR_type"] for pandas 3 named-column semantics
compatibility_patch.scheduler: Keep the outer TIR-Learner multiprocessing.Pool and 16 CPU allocation; do not globally change swifter scheduler

stages: copy preserved normalized genome and EDTA.raw tree to fresh recovery output
extract exact image TIR-Learner modules and apply source-checked compatibility overlay
run EDTA_raw.pl --type tir --overwrite 0 to resume TIR-Learner from copied Module4 Step7 checkpoint
run EDTA.pl --step filter --overwrite 0 --sensitive 1 --anno 1 with unchanged native values
retain complete outputs and status separately from the preserved failure

dependency.reason: Do not exceed the two native CPU recovery concurrency limit
